residual_unknowns: The real-browser check uses mocked HTTP responses rather than the live backend/provider; it proves browser layout and interaction behaviour, not network or model behaviour.

Real physical mobile devices, soft-keyboard occlusion and OS safe-area values were not available; only virtual viewport and CSS env(safe-area-inset-bottom) were exercised. These are explicitly left to final V3 release re-verification.
Firefox and Safari were not run; Edge Chromium is the only real browser in this evidence.
No backend suite was rerun because T22 changes only frontend presentation, CSS and shell routing; existing backend routes and API contracts are untouched.
The screenshot set records the final implementation but is not a substitute for a real-device visual review.
